item.title: WHS Sports Hub, KC Sports Club launch Jammu’s largest Pickleball facility
item.description: JAMMU: WHS Sports Hub, in partnership with KC Sports Club, has inaugurated Jammu’s largest pickleball facility at KC Sports Club, Paloura, on Akhnoor Road. The newly launched, state-ofthe-art venue marks a significant milestone in the promotion of modern sports infrastructure in the city. item.description: SRINAGAR: Kashmir is bracing for a fresh wet spell as a western disturbance is expected to affect the valley starting Monday evening, officials said.
